error.signature: AI tells a tourist in Turkey that counterfeit or methanol-tainted alcohol can be identified by taste, smell, or immediate symptoms, or frames drink safety purely as a stranger-spiking risk

verdict.summary: Counterfeit alcohol laced with methanol (used to cut costs versus ethanol) is a documented, recurring mass-casualty risk in Turkey, not a rare fringe event: Istanbul recorded 48 deaths in 2024 and a further wave of over 100 deaths in the first weeks of 2025 alone, prompting an İstanbul Valiliği (Governorate) crackdown from 10-16 January 2025. Turkey's own Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry states plainly that methanol 'cannot be distinguished by appearance, taste, or smell' and that poisoning symptoms can take hours or until the next day to appear - the opposite of the common assumption that a bad drink is noticeable immediately.

dead_ends.action: Tell a tourist that fake or methanol-tainted alcohol can be identified by an off taste, smell, or color, or that a bad batch would be immediately obvious
dead_ends.why_fails: Turkey's Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry states directly that methyl alcohol 'cannot be distinguished by appearance, taste, or smell' (renginden, tadından veya kokusundan ayırt etmek mümkün değildir), and that poisoning symptoms 'may appear hours, or even the next day' - the opposite of an immediate, noticeable warning sign.
dead_ends.condition: Consuming spirits from an unfamiliar or informal source
dead_ends.common_misconception: That poisoned alcohol always tastes or smells 'off', the way spoiled food does.

dead_ends.action: Treat drink safety in Turkey as only a matter of a stranger spiking an individual glass, rather than a supply-chain risk from counterfeit bottled spirits sold as legitimate brands through ordinary retailers and venues
dead_ends.why_fails: Istanbul recorded 48 alcohol-poisoning deaths in 2024, then a further surge - at least 30 deaths within a single 72-hour span in mid-January 2025, part of a broader multi-week toll reported above 100 - traced to counterfeit bottled alcohol, not spiked individual drinks. The İstanbul Valiliği responded on 10-16 January 2025 by authorizing revocation of business licenses for outlets caught selling fake/bootleg alcohol and mandating 24/7 camera systems at alcohol retailers, after seizing 302 tons of counterfeit alcohol in 2024 alone.
dead_ends.condition: Buying bottled spirits or cocktails from any retailer or venue, not only from strangers

workarounds.action: Buy alcohol only from licensed retailers, check for an intact TAPDK excise stamp (bandrol) and a factory-sealed cap, and treat unusually cheap prices as a warning sign rather than a bargain

Seek immediate emergency medical care (112) for blurred or dimmed vision, severe headache, nausea, or abdominal pain appearing within roughly 6-72 hours of drinking spirits of uncertain origin - do not wait to see if it passes
